newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC to supply satellite system to Russian firm.
newsitem.headline: NEC to supply satellite system to Russian firm.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Thursday that it had received a three billion yen order from the Russian Satellite Communication Co (RSCC) to supply 1,000 relay stations called VSAT systems over a three-year period starting next March.
RSCC is the largest satellite communications enterprise in Russia. It plans to use VSAT to offer telecommunications services to companies with a nationwide network of branches, a NEC spokesman said.
NEC is negotiating a similar deal with Russian gas supplier Gasprom's satellite communications subsidiary, he said.
